verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly from left to right: headline, then copy, then product on its peach circle, then the CTA. Its flaws are that the legal line under the CTA is tiny and hard to read, the eyebrow sits tight against the top edge, the product is shrunk to a minor element, and the body copy is nearly as heavy as the headline. B is clearly broken in several ways. '20% off' is jammed against the body copy, which in turn crowds the CTA. The eyebrow and headline don't share a left edge. The product is shrunk to a speck. The legal text is wrapped into a ragged 5-line column on the right that sits over the cropped circle and pulls attention away from the CTA.
